purpose: Teach: オアシス/戦没/豪雪

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で砂漠のオアシスについて調べてたな
lines.en: Riku, you were the one researching desert oases for social studies, weren't you.
lines.style: Teasing Kansai jab, quick and bright. Knowing smirk audible on the accusation, inviting a comeback.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で戦没者追悼の歴史習ったろ、桜
lines.en: And you learned the history of memorials for the war dead in social studies, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting fast, mumbled start sharpening into the counter. Voice cracking slightly up on her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で豪雪地帯の旅行行ったろ
lines.en: Riku, your family went on that trip to heavy-snow country, right?
lines.style: Rapid-fire follow-up, leaning in. Mock-interrogation energy with a grin bleeding through every word.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で広島の戦没者慰霊碑訪ねたろ、桜
lines.en: You visited the memorial for the war dead in Hiroshima on your school trip, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter, more even now. The Hiroshima memory steadies his voice into something almost serious.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、英語の歌でオアシスの曲覚えたな
lines.en: And you, Riku — you memorized an Oasis song for English class, didn't you.
lines.style: Wry landing, slowed for the punchline. Dry affectionate smirk on the band-name reveal.
